errors.evidence: The color description is incorrect. Only the bar for Deutschland (Germany) is magenta. All other bars are the same shade of light blue. The description falsely claims that the color varies by country and that the USA has a different color than other countries like the UK, Canada, and Australia.

errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in a single descending order. They are split into two groups: negative values and positive values. Within each group, the bars are sorted in ascending order (negative group: -16.3 to -9.4; positive group: 23.3 to 67.7).
